hullFront.note: Hull front/fender panel — Wikinger Soviet skin shows red Soviet star at atlas x=80-152, y=457-548 (center 116, 502). This is the LEFT-in-atlas front hull fender panel; T-34 atlas places both hull sides on frontal panels, not a dedicated side panel. Using hullFront semantic key because these stars are on the glacis/fender area, not a distinct hull-side UV panel. Badge zone encompasses the left star (x=0-276, y=342-662). The RIGHT-in-atlas star at (628, 502) covers the opposite fender.
